metadata.case_name: YU KA KI v. CHAN WING SUM

plaintiff.occupation_before: executive director of an estate agency
plaintiff.occupation_after: executive director of an estate agency

injuries.description: 4.5 cm laceration over forehead resulting in scarring and small patchy loss of hair
source: he was found to have suffered a 4.5 cm laceration over his forehead and dried blood staining opening of nostrils. However, no active nasal bleeding or septal haematoma was found. Suture of laceration was done. The Plaintiff says, in court, that he received 7 stitches.

The laceration caused the Plaintiff to be scarred on his forehead. The scar runs backwards from the hairline in the middle of his forehead to the left, slightly in the shape of a crescent. He complains that the scar resulted in small patchy loss of hair and it made the scar noticeable especially when he was wearing short hair-style.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

manifestations.description: Scar on forehead with small patchy loss of hair

source: Suture of laceration was done. The Plaintiff says, in court, that he received 7 stitches.

treatments_received.treatment: Follow-up outpatient treatment at Ruttonjee and Tang Shiu Kin Hospitals
source: After being discharged from the hospital, he only needed to return once for follow-up outpatient treatment.
for this reason, he received a MRI examination about a year ago but nothing adverse turned up.

treatments_received.treatment: Consultations with dermatologists and plastic surgeons
source: he had consulted several local dermatologists and plastic surgeons, but he could not repose his confidence in them.
he had also consulted one Dr. King of the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital.

treatments_received.treatment: Scar revision operation performed by Dr. Chang (plastic surgeon) in Taiwan
source: he paid a special 4-day trip to Taiwan in May, 2011 to undergo a scar revision operation which was performed by one Dr. Chang, a plastic surgeon there.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Local excision or destruction of lesion or tissue of skin and subcutaneous tissue

losses.description: Scar on forehead causing small patchy loss of hair and affecting appearance and self-esteem
